svg.title: The TX path from a committed request through route::plan to iMessage, Google Voice or email, and the RX path from the mailbox or Messages' database through the reply filter into the inbox and out as an RX readout
svg.text: Gateways: a TX goes out, replies come in
gateway/mod.rs and route.rs for TX; node.rs threads and inbox.rs for RX
SENT n when Messages shows it sent
FAIL n GATEWAY if its fate is unknown
certainly not sent: next route in the plan,
FAIL n GATEWAY if none is left
SENT n when the mail server accepts it
FAIL n GATEWAY on any SMTP error; no email retry
SENT n when the mail server accepts it
FAIL n GATEWAY on any SMTP error
Texts and iMessages begin with a tag, by default

text.tspan: W5XXX via HF radio, replies are read on air:

svg.text: An iMessage-only contact before Messages has been checked gets FAIL n GATEWAY.
RX: replies come in, and are screened before the air
email, carrier SMS, Google Voice texts
from contacts its server vouches for
(carrier SMS: unless it reports a fail)
saved before the mail is marked seen or the read cursor moves
on a notice from a route, or every 60 s;
filter not reached: held, tried again;
the text as sent, with REDACTED,

text.tspan: NR 1 FM MOM SEE YOU SUNDAY ...
